question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.4.
solution: The correct answer is '**Moreover**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The title of the given passage can be 'Dolphin boom in Odisha's Chilika lake'. • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**Moreover**'. • It means '(used for adding another fact) also; in addition'. [(कुछ और जोड़ने के लिए प्रयुक्त) साथ ही; के अतिरिक्त] • *Example: This firm did the work very well. **Moreover**, the cost was not too high.* • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.** **Correct Passage:__** *The rise in the Irrawaddy dolphin population in Chilika can be attributed to the eviction of illegal fish enclosures. After thousands of hectares of Chilika lake were made encroachment free, Irrawaddy dolphins found unobstructed area for movement. **Moreover**, due to the COVID-19 lockdown last year, there were comparatively fewer tourist boats on Chilika lake, which made it (5) ______ for dolphins to move from one part of the lake to another. * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Nevertheless**: in spite of that. (तथापि, ऐसा होने पर भी) • **Whereas**: used for showing a fact that is different. [जबकि (ऐसी स्थिति दर्शाने के लिए प्रयुक्त जो भिन्‍न है)] • **However**: (used for adding a comment to what you have just said) although something is true. [(अभी कही बात के साथ कुछ और कहने के लिए प्रयुक्त) तथापि, तो भी] 47:Td3d, The correct answer is '**conducive**'.
